example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সারা শহরে ঘুরে বেড়িয়ে ক্লান্ত হয়ে গেল।
বাজারে ঘুরতে ঘুরতে অনেক সময় নষ্ট হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He wandered around the whole city and got tired.
Wandering in the market wasted a lot of time.
history: Derived from Ramprasad Sen's devotional song to Goddess Kali, depicting the devotee's aimless wandering like a blindfolded bull in search of the divine mother.
note: The idiom draws from 18th-century Bengali Shakta poetry, emphasizing spiritual quest through physical wandering.
